title: Snap-to-grid layouts for dashboards and canvases
purpose: Add drag-and-drop and resizing to cards while preserving their controls, content, and saved state.
howToUse: Choose dashboardGrid for cards that flow within responsive columns or freeformCanvas for a dotted workspace with pixel coordinates.
Use the profile values as starting defaults. Keep them configurable and derive the visual grid and snapping from the same settings.
Implement sharedRules and the selected profile. Use the acceptance checks to verify the integration.

files.src/components/DashboardGrid.tsx: Measures the container, renders react-grid-layout, and handles drag, resize, and preview state.
files.src/lib/dashboardGridLayout.ts: Defines widget constraints, versioned layouts, normalization, migration, and per-user local storage.
files.src/app/dashboard/page.tsx: Loads and saves the layout and connects customization, reset, visibility, and colors.

sharedRules: Give each widget a stable ID and keep layout data separate from its content and business state.
Use dedicated move and resize handles so buttons, inputs, and other card controls retain their behavior.
Apply live previews during gestures. Commit and save the final geometry on release. Restore the last committed geometry on cancel.
Set per-widget minimum sizes so the content and handles remain usable. Include keyboard controls and visible focus for custom handles.
Load older layouts with defaults for missing fields. Preserve zero coordinates and provide a reset or rearrange action.

interaction: Measure container width and load that breakpoint's layout.
Use a dedicated drag handle. Sunny enables dragging and shows resize handles in Customize mode.
Limit width to the active column count and height to the widget minimum and configured maximum.
Merge visible widgets back into the stored layout when committing. Keep hidden widgets and other breakpoints in state.
Normalize invalid or overlapping entries and add defaults for new widget IDs.

freeformCanvas.boundsPolicy: Clamp the top and left to zero. Expand the scrollable surface to fit the committed items.
freeformCanvas.overlapPolicy: Allow overlap on a freeform canvas. Use a separate collision policy if the app requires it.
interaction: Render dots at the configured step. Snap position changes and resized dimensions to that same step.
Capture the active pointer so mouse, pen, and touch can use the same gesture. Support arrow keys on the handles.
Allow multi-select and assign selected items a shared group ID. Move all group members by the same snapped delta and preserve their relative offsets.
Resize individual items within a group. Provide an Ungroup action that removes the group ID from each member.
Save geometry and group membership with the existing workspace. Clear Canvas styles in other modes while retaining the saved state.
When adapting this to Multi Stopwatch, display notes only in Canvas and retain their content on every mode switch.

acceptanceChecks: Drag and resize by a fractional step and confirm the final geometry lands on the grid.
Activate a card control or edit a field without triggering a layout gesture.
Cancel a gesture and verify the original geometry is restored.
Reload a workspace with saved geometry and a legacy workspace with missing dimensions.
Verify that dashboard layouts stay independent at each breakpoint.
Group a timer and note, move them, and verify their relative offsets survive reload.
Switch from Canvas to Inline and back. Check that the note returns and the timer keeps its timing state.
